plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Infinera transmission device. It reports uptime, memory utilization, and interface traffic, for Infinera optical transport platforms (enterprise PEN 8708).
name: Transmission

metrics.name: load_1m
metrics.description: 1-minute Unix-style load average of each Infinera board (LUM-SYSINFO sysinfoBoardLoadLoad1Min under enterprise PEN 8708). This is a load average, not a 0-100 CPU percent. The query takes the maximum across boards.

metrics.name: load_5m
metrics.description: 5-minute Unix-style load average of each Infinera board (LUM-SYSINFO sysinfoBoardLoadLoad5Min under enterprise PEN 8708). This is a load average, not a 0-100 CPU percent. The query takes the maximum across boards.

metrics.name: load_15m
metrics.description: 15-minute Unix-style load average of each Infinera board (LUM-SYSINFO sysinfoBoardLoadLoad15Min under enterprise PEN 8708). This is a load average, not a 0-100 CPU percent. The query takes the maximum across boards.

metrics.name: memory_usage_percent
metrics.description: Memory utilization of each Infinera board (LUM-SYSINFO sysinfoBoardMemoryUsageMemPercent under enterprise PEN 8708), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage. The query takes the maximum across boards.

metrics.name: memory_total
metrics.description: Optional total board memory reported by LUM-SYSINFO sysinfoBoardMemoryUsageMemTotal (enterprise PEN 8708). Some revisions omit this column. The value is the MIB counter as returned.

metrics.name: memory_free
metrics.description: Optional free board memory reported by LUM-SYSINFO sysinfoBoardMemoryUsageMemFree (enterprise PEN 8708). Some revisions omit this column. The value is the MIB counter as returned.

metrics.name: memory_available
metrics.description: Optional available board memory reported by LUM-SYSINFO sysinfoBoardMemoryUsageMemAvailable (enterprise PEN 8708). Some revisions omit this column. The value is the MIB counter as returned.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
